anchor_comparisons: The positive ordinal anchor is directionally comparable because actual earnings, cash conversion, and revisions strengthen together, although it is not an exact analogue.
The counter ordinal anchor remains relevant to durability risk, but current observed earnings and cash flow are materially stronger than its medium pattern.
disagreements: The analyst appropriately reflects current strength, while the skeptic better captures the missing HBM-only bridge; the calibrated band preserves both.
payload.rationale: Calibration places the component nearer the positive ordinal anchor. Actual earnings, cash conversion, pricing and mix evidence, and revisions support strength; issuer-wide attribution, forecast dependence, reinvestment needs, and customer capital-spending sensitivity constrain persistence.
payload.why_not_higher: Exact product-level earnings and cash conversion, plus durable customer funding beyond FY2026, are not established.
payload.why_not_lower: Observed profitability, free cash flow, DRAM ASP, HBM revenue growth, and revisions are too substantial for a medium-only placement.
